blocks.text: For years, dining out was something reserved for the weekend. Friday dinners, Saturday catchups, and long Sunday lunches were part of the routine. But that habit is changing. Between packed schedules, long commutes, and the rush of the ‘ber-months,’ more people are finding reasons to dine out during the weekdays. Instead of heading straight home, they’re meeting friends after work, enjoying date nights, or taking a break from cooking. What was once time spent in traffic has become an opportunity to unwind over a good meal. That’s one reason SM Megamall has become a go-to destination for weekday dining. With everything […]...
